title: Epithet Miner input
description: Which Project Gutenberg books to mine, how many formulas to keep, and the existing bank to dedupe against. Every field has a default, so an empty input mines four prose translations of the Iliad and the Odyssey.

gutenbergIds.title: Project Gutenberg ebook IDs
gutenbergIds.description: Ebook IDs (or ebook URLs such as https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/3059). Defaults: 3059 Iliad (Lang, Leaf & Myers), 1728 Odyssey (Butcher & Lang), 2199 Iliad (Samuel Butler), 1727 Odyssey (Samuel Butler). Also public domain: 6130 Iliad and 3160 Odyssey (Alexander Pope, verse). A book is mined only if its Gutenberg record says "Public domain in the USA."

maxFormulas.title: Max formulas
maxFormulas.description: The most formulas to output, best first. At most 15 of them, and never more than a fifth, are half-lines.

minCount.title: Minimum occurrences
minCount.description: How many times a formula must occur across all books. Homer's formulas recur; one-off phrases are not formulas. Plain adjectives ("great", "old") need twice this.

maxPerHead.title: Max formulas per name or noun
maxPerHead.description: Keeps the bank varied: at most this many formulas for one head (Zeus, ships, Troy).

includeHalfLines.title: Include half-lines
includeHalfLines.description: Also mine prepositional half-lines such as "over the wine-dark sea" (kind half_line).

modernizeNames.title: Use familiar Greek names
modernizeNames.description: Write names the way players say them: Jove and Minerva (Butler) become Zeus and Athena; Athene, Achaians and Aias (Lang) become Athena, Achaeans and Ajax. Off keeps each translator's spelling.

existingBankUrl.title: Existing bank URL
existingBankUrl.description: URL of the formula bank to dedupe against (a JSON array like MeNIN's content/formulas.json). Formulas already in it, or variants of them ("fleet-footed Achilles" for "swift-footed Achilles"), are dropped.

existingBank.title: Existing bank (JSON)
existingBank.description: The bank pasted as a JSON array of {id, text, ...} entries. Used when no URL is given.

maxRequestsPerMinute.title: Max requests per minute
maxRequestsPerMinute.description: Politeness cap for gutenberg.org. Requests are always made one at a time.

useCache.title: Cache downloaded books
useCache.description: Keep downloaded books in the named key-value store epithet-miner-pg-cache, so later runs don't download them again.
